data.overview: When the small, family-run Bellwether Gazette reports allegations of sex, drugs, and violence inside its county sheriff's office, the family faces retaliation from local authorities. The conflict escalates after the paper obtains a secret recording in which the sheriff and civic officials allegedly discuss killing them, drawing international attention to their investigation.
data.tagline: The story they tried to silence.
data.title: The Gazette Under Siege
